meta.title: Spatial Intelligence Atlas
meta.subtitle: Tourism, Risk & Decision Systems
meta.notice: Five separate systems. Related conceptually, not technically integrated.
meta.provenance: Every node label and every edge marked support="stated" is drawn verbatim from the source project descriptions. Edges marked support="authored" are assertions by the atlas author and may only terminate at e-provisional or e-missing.

rules.R1: Every method label is a verbatim term from a source description. Terms merged into another node are recorded in that node's folds array.
rules.R2: Decision nodes are interrogatives. The atlas claims a system could inform a question; it never claims a system produces a decision.
rules.R3: An edge may terminate at a substantive evidence class (e-real, e-derived, e-calibrated, e-simulated) only when support == "stated".
rules.R4: Edge colour and dash pattern derive solely from edge.evidence. A null value renders as a neutral hairline.
rules.R5: Governance methods (m-evidence-provenance, m-evidence-classification) describe how evidence is audited, not produced. They have no yields_evidence edges and are excluded from decision evidence-floor computation.
rules.R6: conceptually_adjacent is symmetric and non-directional. It must never be drawn with an arrowhead and never implies technical integration.

modes.label: Evidence
modes.question: What is this actually founded on?

nodes.label: HATI
nodes.definition: Heat-aware tourism intelligence for Madrid, concerned with extreme heat and its effect on tourism.
nodes.basis: Source: "HATI — Heat-Aware Tourism Intelligence. Territory: Madrid. Domain: extreme heat and tourism."

nodes.label: FIRSTLOOK-MAD
nodes.definition: Wildfire and interurban environmental risk work situated in Madrid.
nodes.basis: Source: "FIRSTLOOK-MAD. Territory: Madrid. Domain: wildfire / interurban environmental risk."

nodes.label: SNTO
nodes.definition: A smart tourism observatory producing destination intelligence, situated primarily in Guadarrama.
nodes.basis: Source: "SNTO — Smart Tourism Observatory. Territory: primarily Guadarrama / protected destination context."

nodes.label: FIELDOS
nodes.definition: Field observation infrastructure for collecting spatial field data and observations.
nodes.basis: Source: "FIELDOS. Domain: field observation infrastructure." No territory is declared.

nodes.label: FAB
nodes.definition: Related visual research and interface experimentation. Not represented as a data source in v0.1.
nodes.basis: Source: "FAB. Domain: visual/research interface. Role in this atlas: related visual research/interface experimentation, not a data source unless explicitly represented as such."
nodes.note: Has zero applies_method and zero supports_decision edges by design. No explicit representation as a data source exists in v0.1, so no evidence claim is made.

nodes.label: Madrid
nodes.definition: The Madrid urban and municipal context.

nodes.label: Sierra de Guadarrama
nodes.definition: Guadarrama as a protected destination context.
nodes.basis: Source: "Territory: primarily Guadarrama / protected destination context" (SNTO).

nodes.label: No territory declared
nodes.definition: A modelling device, not a place. It makes an undeclared territory visible instead of silently absent.
nodes.basis: No territory is stated for FIELDOS or FAB in the source descriptions.

nodes.label: UTCI
nodes.definition: Universal Thermal Climate Index, named in the HATI method list.

nodes.label: SOLWEIG
nodes.definition: Named in the HATI method list. Its configuration, inputs and validation are not declared in the source description.

nodes.label: Heat exposure
nodes.definition: Assessment of exposure to extreme heat, named in the HATI method list.

nodes.label: Scenarios
nodes.definition: Construction and comparison of modelled conditions rather than observed ones.

nodes.label: Decision engine
nodes.definition: The mechanism by which HATI turns spatial analysis into eligibility outcomes. Its rules are not declared in the source description.

nodes.label: Environmental signals
nodes.definition: Environmental signals used in FIRSTLOOK-MAD. Their sources and processing are not declared.

nodes.label: Real-data acquisition
nodes.definition: Acquisition of real, observed data.

nodes.label: Evidence provenance
nodes.definition: Tracking where evidence came from. A governance method: it audits evidence rather than producing it.

nodes.label: Sentinel-2
nodes.definition: Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, used for remote sensing of the destination.

nodes.label: Open data
nodes.definition: Published open datasets used as an input to destination monitoring.

nodes.label: Evidence classification
nodes.definition: Assigning a status to evidence. A governance method: it labels evidence rather than producing it.

nodes.label: Spatial field data collection
nodes.definition: Collection of observations in the field, including voice-to-text notes, as spatial data.
nodes.basis: Source: FIELDOS "Concepts: field evidence, observations, voice-to-text notes, spatial field data collection".

nodes.label: REAL
nodes.definition: Directly observed or acquired data.

nodes.label: DERIVED
nodes.definition: Computed from other evidence via a declared transformation.
nodes.unused_reason: No source description explicitly supports a DERIVED status. The class is retained in the vocabulary and must render in the legend with a count of 0.

nodes.label: CALIBRATED
nodes.definition: Adjusted or validated against an independent reference.
nodes.unused_reason: No source description explicitly supports a CALIBRATED status. The class is retained in the vocabulary and must render in the legend with a count of 0.

nodes.label: SIMULATED
nodes.definition: Produced by a model under specified conditions.
nodes.unused_reason: No yields_evidence edge terminates at SIMULATED in v0.1. The one concept that named it (scenarios) is held at PROVISIONAL because the supplied description names it but does not explicitly establish its evidence class. The class is retained in the vocabulary and must render in the legend with a count of 0.

nodes.label: PROVISIONAL
nodes.definition: Asserted by this atlas but not substantiated by the source description.

nodes.label: MISSING
nodes.definition: Not declared by the source description. The absence is itself the finding.

nodes.label: Where is intervention spatially eligible?
nodes.definition: Whether a location qualifies for an intervention under the declared spatial criteria.
nodes.basis: Source: HATI "Methods/concepts: spatial eligibility ... decision engine". Promoted from the HATI method list to a decision framing.

nodes.label: How do outcomes differ across scenarios?
nodes.definition: How modelled conditions change the picture relative to one another.

nodes.label: Where is spatial risk concentrated?
nodes.definition: Where environmental risk is concentrated across the territory.
nodes.basis: Source: FIRSTLOOK-MAD "Concepts: ... spatial risk". Promoted from the concept list to a decision framing.

nodes.label: Is the destination changing?
nodes.definition: Whether observable change is occurring in the monitored destination.
nodes.basis: Source: SNTO "Concepts: ... destination monitoring". Promoted from the concept list to a decision framing.

nodes.label: What was actually observed on the ground?
nodes.definition: What was recorded in the field, as distinct from what was modelled or inferred.
